title: Essential finite presentation of affine morphism stalks
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a locally finitely presented morphism of affine schemes, and $x\in X$ [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation; def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $R=\mathcal O_{Y,g(x)}$ and $S=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, with $R$ acting on $S$ by the stalk map [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There exist a commutative ring $P$, compatible algebra structures $R\to P\to S$, and a multiplicative submonoid $W\subseteq P$, such that $P$ is finitely presented over $R$ and $S$ is the localization of $P$ at $W$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra; def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

source.place: Tag 00RH, displayed localized closed-fibre map and application of Tag 00R7

proof.text: Write A=Gamma(Y) and B=Gamma(X). The global section map phi:A to B is finitely presented. The affine stalks are A_p and B_q, with p the contraction of q; germ-stalk-map compatibility identifies the induced map with the given stalk map.

Localize B at M=phi(A minus p) and call the result P. Localization of a finitely presented ring map is finitely presented (Mathlib RingHom.finitePresentation_localizationPreserves, a localized base change), so P is finitely presented over A_p=R.

M lies in B minus q. Localization transitivity, clause (2), makes S=B_q a localization of P at the image of B minus q. The scalar tower is checked on A by localization ring-hom extensionality and germ-stalk-map compatibility.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00RH; explicit affine localization and closed-fibre verifications for its use of 00R7

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finitePresentation_stalk_localization_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] (x : X) :
    let R := Y.presheaf.stalk (g x)
    let S := X.presheaf.stalk x
    letI : Algebra R S := (g.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (P : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : Algebra R P) (_ : Algebra P S),
      IsScalarTower R P S ∧ Algebra.FinitePresentation R P ∧
        ∃ W : Submonoid P, IsLocalization W S
